notes: v2.9.74 AUTO-RUN STABILITY: Fixes automatic trading unexpectedly stopping on any Kiwoom BrokerError. Transient chart, account-query, and read API errors now keep auto trading enabled and retry on the next scan instead of calling stop_auto(). Actual order/cancel requests are separately wrapped as AutoOrderError; if an order state may be unknown, PUMA still performs a safety stop to prevent duplicate orders. Manual reconnect, explicit stop, and app close remain intentional stop paths. Gaboja entry/exit rules remain as v2.9.73.
